brief: Home hand rehab for stroke survivors: big, calm Play screen for the patient, clear dashboard for the therapist. Same content, compare colors, type and controls.

candidates.name: Clinic Sage
candidates.concept: A calm physio room at home: soft sage and white, big round buttons, nothing that rushes the patient.
candidates.typography: Display Segoe UI · Body Segoe UI · Numbers Segoe UI

candidates.name: Chunky Play
candidates.concept: A game first, therapy second: thick saffron buttons that feel good to press, bold numbers that celebrate every tap.
candidates.typography: Display Bahnschrift · Body Segoe UI · Numbers Bahnschrift

candidates.name: Night Lantern
candidates.concept: Coins glow like lamps in a dark room: deep navy screen, warm amber light only where the hand should go.
candidates.typography: Display Segoe UI · Body Segoe UI · Numbers Bahnschrift

candidates.name: Recovery Diary
candidates.concept: A warm notebook of small wins: paper, ink blue and a serif voice, so progress reads like a story, not a chart.
candidates.typography: Display Georgia · Body Segoe UI · Numbers Georgia

candidates.name: Haldi & Indigo
candidates.concept: Rooted in an Indian home: turmeric yellow on deep indigo, Devanagari-ready type, warm like family.
candidates.typography: Display Nirmala UI · Body Nirmala UI · Numbers Nirmala UI
